messages:
Maria P: Heads up — SI co-sell intake bottleneck this week. A couple of leads landed in marketplace and HW partner queues and no clear owner. @ajay @selena can we sync on triage rules? :eyes:
partners-bot: New lead: LW-7321 (AcmeBank) via CloudMarket. Tags: SI-intake, potential-dedicated. Assigned: none
Ajay K: Noted. Is there an existing mapping doc for marketplace -> SI owner? I thought Kendra owns CloudMarket intake.
Kendra L: I own CloudMarket intake but not HW partner claims. For Marketplace leads we claim first if account not already in SDR pipeline within 7 days. For SI-potential leads we kick to SI triage.
Selena R: We need a clear handoff window. Proposed: marketplace claims only if not touched by sales/SDR in 48h, else mark 'confirm with rep' and ping rep. For SI-intent leads, do 24h SI triage check.
Tom B: Agree. Also hardware partners sometimes double-submit. Suggest rule: if HW tag present, route to HW intake owner (Tom) and delay marketplace claim for 24h to allow HW to assert.
Maria P: Proposed quick rubric (working):
```yaml
- source: cloudmarketplace
  owner: Kendra L
  claim_window: 48h
  si_triage: 24h
- source: hardware-partner
  owner: Tom B
  claim_window: 24h
  si_triage: 12h
- SI-intent: notify: @selena, ownership: TBD
```
Ajay K: Can we add 'account mapping' rule: if account tagged 'enterprise' or >$500k ARR, auto-assign to AE (via SFDC owner) and notify partners? That prevents accidental claim.
Kendra L: Yes — insert check against SFDC owner. Also need an audit trail: add a quick Slack action to set 'claimed' and message thread.
Selena R: I'll draft a micro-play for triage steps + template pings to reps and partners. Will post in Partnerships Confluence and ping here when done.
partners-bot: Lead LW-7321 status updated: routed to SI-triage queue (Selena R).
Maria P: Thanks — can everyone react :white_check_mark: when they reviewed the draft? Let's aim to ship a one-pager by EOD Wednesday.
